name: dry_run:log-inventory-app-info-heartbeat-ok-worker-8730:c75fa34a
query:
fetch logs, from: -24h, samplingRatio: 100
| filter service.name == "inventory"
| summarize scope_records = count() * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    target_records = countIf(service.name == "inventory" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "heartbeat ok")) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    matched_records = countIf(service.name == "inventory" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "heartbeat ok")) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    outside_target = countIf((service.name == "inventory" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "heartbeat ok")) and not (service.name == "inventory" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "heartbeat ok"))) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    matched_errors = countIf((service.name == "inventory" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "heartbeat ok")) and in(loglevel, {"ERROR", "FATAL"})) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio)
